_about: Example audit plan for the issue #74 DOM investigation. Copy to plan.json and fill in your own notebook URLs — the real plan files are git-ignored because a notebook URL is an access token. `topic` is human-only (ignored by dom-audit.ts). Each notebook gets 6 grounded questions shaped to trigger every thinking form — short(EN), long-synthesis(EN), table(EN), comparison(EN), JA, PL. 2 notebooks × 6 = 12 NotebookLM calls (free tier is 50/day). locales:[null] because Q5/Q6 already drive the answer/reasoning language via the question itself.
